matches.notes: 70% possession, 16 total shots and 5 shots on target made for some exciting viewing. Grant Hanley had a mare of a night, giving away a penalty then picking up a red card - he should have stayed at home. But Motherwell shut Hibs down before all that had happened. Fresh legs from a change in lineup and some fantastic passing football was on display. If we can keep playing like that for the rest of the season, it will be a joy to watch. That said Calum Ward was found out by Boyle and it was only the incredible back tracking from Koutrombis that kept it a clean sheet - extra shredded wheat for him! #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Possession at 59%, but fewer total shots or shots on target than Kilmarnock shows this wasn't perhaps as positive a result as the score would make you think. A very dubious penalty decision that didn't go Killies way and as usual some calamitous work from Calum Ward between the sticks for us. But most incredibly Elijah Just played, having just returned from international duties for New Zealand, and made an important impact too.  Our first two goals, from Maswanhise were well taken opportunities, with the second coming from a set piece straight off the training grounds. Much needed three points - but still no clean sheet in goals. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Another game of high possession, but not enough goals. 65% overall, more shots on goal but only one in the back of the net. Lots to enjoy, but still frustrating to not be taking all three points back to Fir Park. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

A dire performance. Far too much respect and fear shown towards St. Mirren. Goodness knows why, but the back passing and dithering was woeful. Once again our player in the goals, not a goalkeeper in my opinion, was useless. But he is not alone in his incompetence. Some players could barely pass a ball to their own teammates, or when they did, it was so slow or obvious an interception was coming. Didn't deserve anything from this game and best of luck to St. Mirren in the final. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

A slow mid week start, but still dominant in possession for the first half. Chances going stray and some tightness needed, then a nicely worked goal before the break settled some nerves. United came back into it in the second half, but the 'Well stood strong and defended nicely. A peach of a hit from Elliot Watt to open his account and the game was put to bed. Steadily seen out with more determined defence work. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

A promising start undone by a penalty from a tackle that didn't need to happen. But continued pressure from the 'Well and lots to be happy about. Just and Slattery paired up for a lot of the play, but a mad moment from Livi gave us the penalty and equaliser. Just got a goal chopped off, but didn't put his head down and his winner was a worthy reward for his efforts. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Another defeat snatched from the jaws of victory. Brilliant first half, with lots of chances created and some dubious VAR decisions. But instead of coming out stronger and more determind in the second half we collectively switched off. Two goals disallowed and heads down - means we realistically got what we deserved out of it. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Couldn't watch the game live, I was just too nervous. Ward made another howler, how many has that been this season. In a game that everyone has to be at their best, he passes the ball out to a Celtic player - I give up. A good performance, other than that, with Celtic being pushed more than by other teams for sure. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Back to majority share of possession (63.5%), but began with a nervy few minutes. Calum Ward being called upon to make a save from an effort from Nisbet. Some crunching tackles let go by the referee, but eventually he found his cards and produced yellow a couple of times for some of the Dons players - who got subbed off shortly afterwards. It took into stoppage time for Motherwell to find the net, though they had been dominant for large periods of the first and second halves.  An horrendous error from the Dons keeper let an easy stop trickle through for our opening goal. Instead of playing out the clock the 'Well went for another goal and were rewarded with a penalty, slightly soft to be fair, but taken very convincingly by Stamatelopoulos. Puts us 4th in the league. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Much lower possession for the match than we have had during league games so far this season, but that doesn't matter a jot - we won a game! Clean sheet and more goals than the opposition. Job done !!! Semi-finals here we come - Hampden here we come!!! #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Described by Askou after the match as the best and worst he's seen them play this season. First half was free flowing and owned the game. Second half a total lack of concentration from all the players on a set piece and we lose a very soft goal. Being a man up should have put us back in the drivers seat, but we looked more nervy if anything. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Perhaps showed Killie too much respect in the opening half hour, but got our equaliser on half time. Same story as last week, get a lead then unable to hold onto it. It's great to have exciting football and to remain unbeaten, but it would be really nice to win a game in the league too.  #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Lions share of possession in the first half and a score of goals, what is not to like. But the last 25 minutes will need a serious review to see what went wrong and how to improve. As before the managers interview after the match was the definition of coaching - nothing to be dissappointed with, only opportunities to improve. We are all learning the new playing style and I for one am happy with the results. A win would be nice, but very nice to watch and great to see Derek McInnes sweating in the home dugout. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Once again - lots of possession but not any precision in the final third. First game since the record transfer fee from Lennon Miller going to Udinese, but we need to fill the void and get a striker or two on the squad. No use having 70% possession, but 0-0 draw after 90 minutes. Through the the quarter-finals and onwards from there hopefully. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

A lot of possession but not any precision. Sad story from an otherwise impressive display from the Well. A few good chances that came to nothing, but not a game to remember. Windy conditions ruined the game, but a share of the points is better than a loss. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

A sloppy goal conceded from self inflicted corner, was not part of the game plan. But since when do Motherwell make it easy on themselves. They held out for the remainder of the first have, with a smattering of opportunities to speak of themselves. But the plan was fully executed for the majority of the second half. Dominant, free flowing and most of all joyous to watch. Rangers were not just on the back foot, they were beaten to every ball, every half chance. Their own manager expressed his lack of confidence in post match interviews, saying they were lucky to get a point. Jens Berthel Askou was genuinely disappointed with the result, half expecting to get all three points. But it was not to be, either way if this is the future - bring in on! #claret&amber  #COYW!!

At last. A game that Motherwell have controlled and looked close to comfortable, for the majority of play.  Many commentators praised the team for commited and progressive play, with the manager saying he'd rather they made mistake for being to adventurous than from sitting back and being safe.  An easy tap in for Stamatelopoulos and a double for Maswanhise - his second goal was an absolute SCREAMER.  If this is the way we can play against one of the first 'proper' teams we've faced, then we should be in good shape for the season ahead. Let's just hope its a taste of things to come under our new manager.  #COYW!!
Third painful game in a row. Weather played a big part in the match, as well as the tattie field they called a pitch. Write it up as a win, but nothing to celebrate on the road back home.  #COYW!!

Another nervy performance from a team clearly finding it's way through the game. The Longelo goal was a screamer and gives me hope for better things to come. But we can only pray this is pre-season jitters and the team will come good in the league.  #COYW!!
Far from convincing, slightly worrying to be fair. To get the bonus point and win penalties is good, but should never have needed to take that long. #COYW!!
